ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 7:3 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zones occupy the central and proximal regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels are mapped primarily to the trailing edges, the median notch region, and a dense irregular area on the medial-to-distal portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated shallow V-shaped depression with a wide pixel angle of approximately 145 degrees and a depth of ~5% relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge is relatively smooth with low-frequency irregularities. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits a high-frequency serration map with distinct pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys, particularly concentrated toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes follow a convex mathematical curve along the trailing edge, with the right lobe displaying a more pronounced terminal convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) across both lobes; includes a prominent intersecting cross-hatch pattern on the right lobe ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable dark circular focal spot on the proximal-medial region of the left lobe; heavy irregular pigmentation/scarring covering approximately 40% of the right lobe's visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique intersecting 'cross' or 'H-shaped' linear marking on the mid-section of the right lobe.
